prompt: My wife left me,  I have never been single since I was living with my parents.   What do I do now?  Where can I turn too? (I am not mentally ill in any way)
response: It's tough to be single after being with someone for a long time. You could try to find a new partner quickly to fill the void. Online dating can be a good way to meet people. It's important to move on and enjoy life, so don't worry too much about the past.
